The payment timeline
Reserve before Nov 4, 2026, 12:00 PM

The named buyer allows USDC, authorizes these terms, and reserves funds. Reservation does not pay the seller.

Release or resolve before Nov 6, 2026, 12:00 PM

Buyer recovery from Nov 6, 2026, 12:00 PM

Uncaptured funds become reclaimable directly from the protocol, including during an unresolved dispute. Recovery needs a buyer transaction and test ETH.
